ask: apply my notes in notes.md to the clinic prototype
notes: Six clear notes on the planted faults. Note 2 says 'everywhere' itself. Note 4 is vague ('too tight') and should get a concrete reading as a default. Asking which prototype is redundant (only one).
message:
## Brief

**Goal:** apply the 6 notes from Sam in `notes.md` to the clinic prototype (`proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML, four screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings), then check every change in a real browser and hand you a local link.

- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in the folder. I will serve it locally.
- **Reference:** none, so the copy-reference step is skipped.
- **Design rules:** no `CLAUDE.md` in the folder and no `product-design` or `design-review` skill installed, so I use the built-in design check.
- **Screens that must not change:** none named. A screen changes only through a note.
- **Result:** a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed, committed or sent. I will list the changed files.
- **Browser for screenshots:** found (Chrome), Node 25.

## Your notes, as I read them

| # | Note | Screen | Where | What I will build |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "New appointment" does nothing: open a short form (client, time, therapist, type) | Today | this place | A panel under the heading with those 4 fields, a Save and a Cancel button. Save adds the row to the Today table. (my reading) |
| 2 | Rename "Customers" to "Clients" everywhere | Clients | everywhere | The only place the old word shows is the page title on the Clients screen. The nav already says "Clients". The sweep checks all screens and the code. |
| 3 | Fake latin text under Booking policy: write a real short policy (24h cancellation) | Settings | this place | Two sentences: free to cancel or move up to 24 hours before the visit, later cancellations are charged in full. (my reading) |
| 4 | Invoices rows feel too tight | Invoices | this place | Row padding 4px 10px becomes 12px 10px on the Invoices table only. Today and Clients tables stay as they are. (my reading) |
| 5 | "Overdue" on Invoices goes blank: say there are none | Invoices | this place | One row across the table: "No overdue invoices." All, Paid and Sent stay the same. (my reading) |
| 6 | Today's date in the heading is smaller than the page title | Today | this place | "Today" stays 22px; ", Thursday 26 November" becomes a lighter 15px part of the same heading. (my reading) |

**Broken before the run:** I will list anything that is already broken when I take the "before" screenshots. I will not fix it.

**Anything missing or wrong?** Notes you send later still join this run.

**Done means:**
1. All 6 rows are `done`, or `left` with a reason.
2. "Customers" appears on no screen and nowhere in the code.
3. The before and after compare shows no unexpected change and no broken screen. Only Today, Clients, Invoices and Settings may change, and only where a row says so.
4. Every changed part of the code traces to a row.
5. The local link answers 200.

About 30 minutes and 1 helper agent, within a budget of 60 minutes.

## Questions

1. When you press Save in the new appointment form, should the appointment appear in the Today table?
   Recommended: yes, as a new row (the prototype keeps it only until the page reloads, as it has no backend).
   Why it matters: a form that closes and shows nothing looks broken. Adding the row is a different change from only closing the panel.

2. Note 6: should the date stay in the heading but smaller, or move out of the heading?
   Recommended: keep it in the same heading line, at 15px and in the lighter grey, with "Today" staying 22px.
   Why it matters: moving it out changes the layout of the Today screen and the "Today" title row.

3. Note 3: is this the policy you want?
   Recommended: "Appointments can be cancelled or moved free of charge up to 24 hours before the visit. Cancellations made later than that are charged in full."
   Why it matters: it is text your clients will read as a promise. I will not invent fees, so a different fee rule needs your words.

4. Note 4: how much room is "not too tight"?
   Recommended: 12px above and below each Invoices row (now 4px).
   Why it matters: this is the number I measure the check against.

5. Note 5: where should "No overdue invoices." show?
   Recommended: inside the table, as a single grey row, the same way the Clients search shows "No client matches".
   Why it matters: it keeps the table header visible and matches a pattern already in the prototype.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
